audience: Local photographer or operator reviewing deterministic render history on a desktop browser.
job_to_be_done: Find an existing render recipe, understand its look-approximation status, and inspect its immutable input/output identity without modifying files.

secondary_information: input and output paths plus hashes

states.partial: Show valid and invalid cards plus a warning summary.
states.invalid: Show invalid cards and a fail-closed summary.
states.loading: Not applicable because the document is fully rendered before open.
states.disabled: Not applicable because there are no actions beyond search.

security_privacy.content_security_policy: default-src none; inline style/script only; no image or connect source

claim_ceiling: Private self-contained read-only desktop browser document only; no live server, file watcher, preview decode/render, export authorization, packaging, telemetry, calibrated stock or product-release claim.
